subject: Shiny app crashes after deployed in the cloud

messages.author: b1d97992057bd9de
messages.subject: Shiny app crashes after deployed in the cloud
parts:
I have an app that works perfect when run locally.  However, when I deploy it to the cloud (via io) it crashes after only a few minor changes.  Here is the JC error console message:

[Log]  (shiny-server-pro.js, line 275)
Listening on http://127.0.0.1:40777
Loading required package: ggplot2
rgdal: version: 0.8-16, (SVN revision 498)
Geospatial Data Abstraction Library extensions to R successfully loaded
Loaded GDAL runtime: GDAL 1.7.3, released 2010/11/10
Path to GDAL shared files: /usr/share/gdal/1.7
GDAL does not use iconv for recoding strings.
Loaded PROJ.4 runtime: Rel. 4.7.1, 23 September 2009, [PJ_VERSION: 470]
Path to PROJ.4 shared files: (autodetected)
# This research was partially supported under NSF Grant ATM-0534173
#
Loading required package: maps
Warning: Removed 66 rows containing non-finite values (stat_density2d).
Warning: Removed 66 rows containing missing values (geom_point).
Warning: Removed 645 rows containing non-finite values (stat_density2d).
Warning: Removed 645 rows containing missing values (geom_point).
Warning: Removed 36 rows containing non-finite values (stat_density2d).
Warning: Removed 36 rows containing missing values (geom_point).
/opt/shiny-server/scripts/shiny-run: line 3:    15 Killed                  /bin/bash --login -c "$SHINY_EXEC_COMMAND $SHINY_R_PATH $*"


I'm afraid I can't make any sense of it.  I have a ggplot overlaid with spatial data which is causing the crash but I'm not sure why.  Any input is appreciated.  The app is here:

https://analyticspro.shinyapps.io/MedicalGeoSpatial/

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app crashes after deployed in the cloud
parts:
Isaac,

You may want to try increasing your applications memory size using the configureApp command in shinyapps package:

configureApp("your-app-name", size="large")

Hope that helps.

Also, I'd like to refer you to the shinyapps-users group for further questions related to ShinyApps.

-Andy
